formats.key: invest(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient, uint256 proofAmount, bytes32[] proofWL)
effects: Pulls `amount` of the collateral `token` from the signer into PutManager, which deposits it into the token's yield vault.
Mints a pFT put-position NFT to `recipient`. The NFT holds an FT allocation (ftOut) and a strike, both priced by the oracle at execution time.
When an ACL is set and proofAmount is not zero, uses up `amount` of the signer's (msg.sender's) whitelist allocation, capped at proofAmount.
formats.shown: Invest 0.195 wS: Collateral 0.195 wS, Recipient address, Whitelist cap as a raw integer.

findings.title: invest: the screen never says a pFT put-position NFT is minted to Recipient
findings.evidence: PutManager.sol _invest: `id = pFT.mint(recipient, amount, ftOut, strike, token, ftPerUSD);` Case 0: NFT 0x1d8051c9… #177 minted to the signer (signer in). The screen has only 'Recipient' and the intent 'Invest {amount}'. The reader: 'Nothing is listed as arriving'.
findings.fix: Label recipient 'Position (pFT NFT) recipient' and set interpolatedIntent to 'Invest {amount} for a FT put position to {recipient}'.

findings.title: invest: interpolatedIntent leaves out the recipient, who may be someone other than the signer
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'Invest {amount}'. _invest has payer = msg.sender and recipient = the parameter, so a third party can get the position.

findings.title: invest: Whitelist cap appears as a raw integer with no token decimals
findings.evidence: descriptor proofAmount format 'raw'. Case 0 screen 'Whitelist cap: 10000000000000000000000'. _invest calls `ftACL.invest(msg.sender, token, amount, proofAmount)`, which compares it with the amount in token units.
findings.fix: Use tokenAmount with tokenPath 'token' for proofAmount.

findings.title: invest: the FT allocation and strike come from the oracle and are not in the calldata
findings.evidence: _invest: `(ftOut, strike, ftPerUSD) = getAssetFTPrice(token, amount, ...)` reads ftOracle at execution time.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The intent could say the FT amount is set at the oracle price.

cases.notes: 0.195 wS out is shown right. The pFT NFT #177 that arrives is shown only through the Recipient address. The reader expected some position but did not know it was an NFT, or how much FT it holds.

effects: Reduces the FT allocation of put position `id` by amount_ft, which exercises the put on that part.
Withdraws collateral from the vault and sends it to the signer. The amount is amount_ft converted at the position's stored strike and ftPerUSD, in the position's collateral token.
formats.shown: Divest 0.003 FT from pFT NFT #137, with fields Position and FT amount.

findings.title: divest: the screen never says collateral comes back; 'FT amount' reads as FT leaving
findings.evidence: PutManager.sol divest: `_vault.withdraw(_capitalDivesting, msg.sender);` Case 1: the signer received 300 units of 0x29219dd4… (USDC), which the screen does not mention. The intent is 'Divest FT PUT', the field 'FT amount'. The reader: 'Arrives: Not stated on screen'.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Exercise put: give up {amount_ft} FT from {id}, receive collateral back' and label amount_ft 'FT given up'.

findings.title: divest: collateral token and amount come from the position's stored strike and cannot be displayed
findings.evidence: divest: `(address token,,,,,, uint256 strike,, uint64 ftPerUSD) = pFT.puts(id); collateralFromFT(amount_ft, strike, ...)`

cases.notes: The signer received 0.0003 USDC of collateral. The screen shows only the 0.003 FT claim reduced, and the reader did not know what would arrive.

effects: Sends `amount` FT from PutManager to the signer.
Reduces position `id` by `amount` FT and permanently forfeits the matching collateral backing (the put right), which is booked to capitalDivesting for the msig.
formats.shown: Withdraw 1.109 FT from pFT NFT #143, with fields Position and FT amount.

findings.title: withdrawFT: the intent does not say the put protection for this amount is given up
findings.evidence: PutManager.sol withdrawFT, comment 'Withdraw FT (invalidating PUT position)'; `pFT.withdrawFT(msg.sender, id, amount, _capitalDivesting); capitalDivesting[token] += _capitalDivesting;` The intent is 'Withdraw FT from PUT'. The reader was unsure about 'lost put/redemption rights'.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Exit put: withdraw {amount} FT from {id} and give up its collateral redemption'.

cases.notes: 1.10937447955392 FT arrived to the signer, matching the screen.

couldNotCheck: The pFT position contract 0x1d8051c90076faa5b683a3551ee4369d00f99d67 (mint, divest, withdrawFT, puts) is not in the directory, so I could not check the position reduction or burn and the ownership checks.
The collateral vault (IftYieldWrapper, e.g. 0x62ebd646… / 0x0e959ea4…) is not in the directory. The withdraw path to the signer is confirmed only through the receipts.
